tx:
To be able to create this pickaxe and complete the achievement A Song of Earth and Pickaxes, a player needs to meet the following requirements:
Aside from the 90 Smithing requirement to create the pickaxe (up to 83 with boosts), completion of three Mythic quests is required, which each bring their own skill requirements. The inclusion of several combat skills makes the pickaxe unobtainable for skill pures.
Once all items are obtained, the pickaxe can be created at a dragonkin anvil (Dragon forge) in the Ancient Cavern, found just south of Kuradal.
